verdict.rationale: Devin has a documented API for automating workflows and creating sessions programmatically, which a CI job could call. Devin Review with Auto-Fix is documented as iterating on CI failures, so fixing failing builds and tests is covered for PRs. However, nothing shows a first-party mechanism for triggering Devin directly from a CI/CD pipeline; the pipeline trigger would have to be built by hand on top of the API. Missing for 10: a documented CI/CD integration (e.g. a pipeline action/plugin or failure-webhook trigger), an end-to-end guide for pipeline-initiated build-fix sessions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
